record.title: Evaluate broad reception and software-arm response differences
record.intent: Report what the descending exploratory sweep establishes and what needs a narrower follow-up.
requirements: Independently reduce every preserved record using the same whole-record metric and report all visits, weak/constant/partial outcomes, actual sample rate, relevant folded-frequency expectations and descriptive arm differences. Do not compare fitted peak directly with RMS, discard inconvenient records or assume source amplitude is flat.

Distinguish sampled reception, alias observations, software configuration evidence and conditional arm contrast from physical fundamental identification, causal patch benefit and calibrated analog bandwidth. Preserve original failed matched comparison status and exact remaining uncertainties.

Publish a concise source-relative report with artifact seals and next smallest useful question. Verify known-safe restoration, helper retirement, taskctl currency and a clean pushed checkout. No further physical experiment is implicitly admitted by this decision.
acceptance: The operator receives a direct evidence-backed stock versus derived descending result or exact blocker without inflated bandwidth claims.
